description: This file contains functions and type definitions for processing booking data, including extracting field values, handling attendee information, and transforming booking data into CSV format. It is specific to insights services related to booking and event management.

methods.name: extractFieldValue
methods.description: Extracts a string value from various data types, handling nested objects with 'value' property.

methods.name: isSystemField
methods.description: Checks if a given field name is a system-defined field.

methods.name: getPhoneFieldsForSeatedEvent
methods.description: Retrieves phone-type booking fields for seated events, excluding system phone fields.

methods.name: getAllFieldsForNonSeatedEvent
methods.description: Retrieves all non-system booking fields and identifies phone fields for non-seated events.

methods.name: processBookingAttendees
methods.description: Processes attendee data for a booking, including formatting attendee info and responses.

methods.name: processBookingsForCsv
methods.description: Processes an array of bookings to generate a map of processed data, tracking max attendees and question labels.

methods.name: formatCsvRow
methods.description: Formats a booking record into a CSV-compatible row, including date/time formatting and attendee info.

methods.name: getUtmDataForBooking
methods.description: Extracts UTM tracking parameters from a booking.

methods.name: transformBookingsForCsv
methods.description: Transforms raw CSV data and bookings into an array of CSV rows with enriched data.
